answer: Sybil resistance binds each identity to bonded collateral, so correlated equivocation by \(k\) coordinated identities triggers penalties scaling as \(O(k^2)\), not merely a sum of isolated offenses. Detection also applies an exponential multiplier to the swarm’s capital loss, amplified by asymmetric depreciation of slashed bonds; splitting control across aliases therefore increases exposure rather than reducing it. The trellis of attestations reveals shared misconduct, leaving no oasis where stolen nectar can hide.
